_doc: Single source of truth for pipeline rules. Every limit carries its source. Values marked CALIBRATE are placeholders that only record, never reject, until calibrated on real batches.

paths.base: F:\2. Microstock\2. Setelah Edit\1. Gambar\1. Dari Claude
paths.upload_queue: F:\2. Microstock\2. Setelah Edit\1. Gambar\1. Dari Claude\_UPLOAD_QUEUE

naming._source: Nathan, 2026-10-25: own counter in 1. Dari Claude, Flow project C-Day N, filenames without spaces

composition._source: Nathan, 2026-10-25: composition stays the same as the existing routine

qc._min_pixels_source: Adobe Stock minimum 4 MP for photos/illustrations (existing routine rule; re-verify against Adobe help)
qc._near_dup_source: Common dHash convention; CALIBRATE on real batches

adobe._title_source: Adobe CSV doc: title max 70 chars, no commas (helpx.adobe.com/stock/contributor/manage-your-portfolio/csv-requirements-content.html). IPTC IIM 2:05 ObjectName is limited to 64 bytes by spec. 64 satisfies both without truncation.
adobe._keywords_source: Adobe titles-and-keyword guide: up to 49; min 45 is Nathan's existing rule

vecteezy._columns_source: vecteezy.com/blog/contributor/contributors-use-a-csv-to-upload-metadata-faster: first four columns must be Filename, Title, Description, Keywords
vecteezy._keywords_source: vecteezy.com/blog/contributor/contributor-checklist: maximum of 30 keywords, at least 10 recommended
vecteezy._unverified: Third-party (photokeyworder) claims, not yet confirmed on Vecteezy's own pages: SFTP upload with credentials from Content Manager, mandatory 'AI-Generated?' checkbox + tool dropdown in Add Data, 1 MB minimum file size, title max 200 chars.

metadata._banned_source: ai/generative/generated/stock/vertical/horizontal: existing routine. Tool names and resolution tags: Adobe generative-AI guide (no 'generative AI', no platform-specific parameters).
